note.zh-TW: 網站補充的名稱：教材以例子換算、沒有命名，年報未列；延伸指標，不計分。
note.en: A name supplied by the site: the course works it out by example without naming it and annual reports do not list it; an extension ratio, not scored.

definition.zh-TW: 從賒購到付清貨款平均要幾天，用一年的天數除以應付款項週轉率算出。天數越多表示供應商給的付款寬限越長。
definition.en: The average number of days between a credit purchase and its payment, found by dividing the days in a year by payables turnover. More days mean longer credit from suppliers.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
